projects.description: Mixed-level Stata teaching site with browser practice and native examples

assets.title: Browser Stata numerical contract

assets.title: STATAverse student overhaul red-team review
assets.summary: Reproduced defects, repairs and remaining verification limits

assets.title: Independent R OLS and HC1 reference fixture
assets.summary: Six model/covariance combinations on synthetic practice data
limits: Fixture-specific numerical checks, not a global error guarantee

assets.title: Native Stata scalar-semantic fixture
assets.summary: Executed missing-value, exponent and function cases
limits: Twelve scalar cases do not establish complete parser equivalence

assets.title: R verification of browser regression

assets.title: Stata teaching source checks

limits: Targeted documentation checks, not validation of all legacy reading material

assets.title: R verification of conventional HC1 and clustered inference

assets.title: Native Stata grouped and row-statistic fixtures

limits: Finite synthetic cases; no weights, by prefixes, extended missing values or general egen expressions
Browser double storage and string collation limits documented separately
